text: This solution, Developing Climate Disaster Risk Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji (Pilot) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Fiji between Government of Fiji entities, Central Bank of Fiji, UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF), UN Development Programme (UNDP), UN University – Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS), India-UN Development Partnership Fund, UN Office for South-South Cooperation (UNOSSC), Local insurers, Weather Risk Agencies, Mobile Network Operators, and Cane Farmers’ Cooperative Savings and Loans Association (CCSLA). The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration, accessibility, and raising awareness.
